name: Auric Solar-Host
identity: The portrait faction: a pure-elite host. Gilded demigods (golden guardians / storm-forged paladin, tier 3) lead oath-sworn power-armoured Battle-Brothers (power-armoured super-soldiers, tier 2). Melee-first with specialised shooting. No chaff: 23–26 models at 1,000 pts.

rules.name: Martial Stances & Solar Overdrive
rules.description: Command Phase: choose 1 Stance for the whole army this round: Aegis (incoming PEN −1) · Vanguard (ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT] and +1 to Hit within 12″) · Executioner (melee weapons gain [ONSLAUGHT 1]). HIGH RISK — Solar Overdrive (⟳ once per round, one unit, when it activates): +1 Attack on all weapons and [SHREDDING WOUNDS] this activation, but its ARM is 1 worse until it next activates.

rules.name: Gamble — Solar Overdrive
rules.description: Once per round, one unit, when it activates: +1 Attack on all weapons and [SHREDDING WOUNDS] this activation, but its ARM is 1 worse until it next activates. (Risk: exposure (durability).)

detachments.name: Gilded Host
detachments.playstyle: golden guardians-style: golden elites hold the centre; every model a hero.

rules.name: Unbroken Phalanx
rules.description: Gilded units within 3″ of an objective count +1 CTRL per model; in Aegis Stance they also gain [WARD 5+] against ranged attacks.

enhancements.name: Sunforged Aegis
enhancements.description: **High Aurarch Praetor** only. The bearer has [WARD 3+] (the best ward in the game; single model only).

enhancements.name: Blade of the First Oath
enhancements.description: **Blade-Warden Champion** only. The bearer's blades: +2 Attacks, +1 Damage.

stratagems.name: Gilded Vigil
stratagems.turn: A Gilded unit controls an objective at the End of Round

stratagems.name: Golden Riposte
stratagems.turn: A Gilded unit is declared as a Charge target
stratagems.effect: It gains [STRIKE FIRST] against that charger this round.

detachments.name: Gene-Forged Host
detachments.playstyle: Space-Marine-style: Sworn Battle-Brothers in numbers, Vanguard drops, tanks.

rules.name: Oath-Doctrines
rules.description: Rounds 1–2 Devastator (+1 PEN on ranged when not moving), Round 3 Tactical (re-roll Wound 1s), Round 4 Assault (+1 Attack in melee). Sworn units only.

enhancements.name: Master-crafted Sol-bolter
enhancements.description: **Sworn Lieutenant** only. The bearer's pistol: +2 Attacks, +1 PEN.

detachments.name: Sunfall Spearhead
detachments.playstyle: Drop-assault: Vanguard, Paladins and Lancers strike from orbit.

rules.name: Comet Descent
rules.description: [VANGUARD STRIKE] units may arrive 7″ from enemies (not 8″) and get +1 to Wound on the activation they arrive.

enhancements.name: Comet Banner
enhancements.description: **Sworn Lieutenant** only. The bearer and its attached unit gain [VANGUARD STRIKE].

enhancements.name: Sunfall Brand
enhancements.description: **Blade-Warden Champion** only. +1 Damage on the activation the bearer arrives or charges.

stratagems.name: Orbital Lance
stratagems.effect: Pick an enemy unit within 12″ of it: D3 Fatal Wounds.

stratagems.name: Thunderous Landing
stratagems.turn: A unit arrives within 9″ of an enemy

stratagems.name: Recall to Orbit
stratagems.effect: One unengaged [VANGUARD STRIKE] unit returns to Strategic Reserves.
